_comment: Manifest for cross-machine Claude Code user-level alignment. Defines what files in ~/.claude/ are governed by this SSOT. scripts/sync-claude-userlevel.ps1 reads this. Edit this file to add/remove governed files.

hooks.description: Cross-machine identical hooks (uses ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} and ~ paths, no machine-specific values)

settings.description: Cross-machine settings; allow list stays per-machine (auto-accumulated, may contain ephemeral entries)

mcp.description: Per CLAUDE.md, ~/.claude/mcp.json must be empty; project-scoped .mcp.json is the SSOT
